attributes.board_name: Minnesota Board of Occupational Therapy Practice

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least half directly related to OT practice. Unlimited: conferences, lectures, workshops, in-service, seminars; college courses (grade C or pass; 1 credit = 6 contact hours); documented courses from AOTA-approved or expert sponsors. Max half of required hours: teaching (up to 2 h prep per contact hour), ACOTE student supervision (1 h per 8 h), research/outcome studies. Max 2 hours: personal-skill topics, BLS/CPR, a year on a professional committee or board. Not accepted: rounds, volunteering, non-educational meetings, employer orientation/annual trainings.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued for less than two years: prorated hours by months licensed.
rules.audit_note: Report hours on the Board's CE reporting form; random audits, plus late renewals and licensees with complaints may be audited. Keep documentation 2 years after the end of the biennial period.
rules.notes: Hours must be earned between the license effective and expiration dates (2-year licensure period). Deferral possible for illness, injury, financial or family hardship on written request.
